caption:
UWS Briefly · Nov 12

• The Health Department shut Carrot, the health-food place at 2169 Broadway, after finding evidence of mice and flies. It opened in June.
• A white Rolls-Royce and a line of black Escalades have been parked illegally on W. 66th near Central Park West for more than two weeks. West Side Rag hasn't seen a ticket on any of them.

Links to every story are in our bio.
